codeReview.summary: Clean, well-structured implementation that widens both the evaluator and dispatcher handoff projections. The worker followed TDD (red-green-refactor), wrote 22 new tests covering all 8 VAL-HANDOFF assertions, and all 3381 tests pass with clean typecheck. Schema changes are additive (all new fields are optional), preserving full backward compatibility. The execution-loop changes correctly propagate warnings and decisions through both the initial evaluation and revision loop paths. The buildLastWorkerResult consumer correctly defaults new fields to empty arrays when absent. The evaluator pick-set test was correctly updated to use a field (plan_file_path) that is genuinely not in the pick set. No bugs or missing edge cases found.

issues.description: buildLastWorkerResult always populates decisions/warnings/commands_run/files_to_review as concrete arrays (via ?? []), but LastWorkerResultSchema declares these fields as optional. This means the consumer always produces values that exceed the schema's minimum contract. Not a bug — the schema correctly accepts both — but there's a subtle asymmetry: code consuming LastWorkerResult via the TypeScript type will see these as possibly-undefined, but in practice buildLastWorkerResult never produces undefined for them. A minor improvement would be to make the fields required in LastWorkerResultSchema with .default([]), or to add a JSDoc note on buildLastWorkerResult clarifying the always-present guarantee.

VAL-HANDOFF-008 tests for 'graceful fallback on invalid handoffs' test the undefined-handoff path by manually checking (cachedHandoff ? ... : undefined), which replicates the execution-loop pattern but doesn't actually exercise the execution-loop's error handling code (the try/catch around readHandoff). A more thorough test would mock readHandoff to throw HandoffInvalidError and verify the execution loop handles it. However, this is acceptable because the execution-loop's error handling is already covered by tests in tests/handoff/reader.test.ts and tests/unified-execution-loop.test.ts.
